title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
abstract: arXiv:2610.12766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication. Because nearly two-thirds of curated devices share their exact recipe with another, random splits primarily reward the mere recall of historical data rather than testing true physical generalisation. To solve this, we mapped the institutional provenance of the Perovskite Database and established a rigorous hierarchy of grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions. Benchmarking thirteen models establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all splits and reveals a critical regime shift: while tree ensembles dominate random splits by recognising familiar recipes, their ranking collapses on genuinely unseen institutions and future discoveries, where composition-aware neural architectures excel. translated_title: 钙钛矿光伏中机器学习评估的来源分组协议
translated_abstract: 用于钙钛矿太阳能电池的机器学习模型通常采用随机数据划分进行评估，我们证明了这种做法会因大规模的内部数据重复而系统性地泄漏信息。由于整理后的器件中近三分之二与另一个器件共享完全相同的制备配方，随机划分主要奖励的是对历史数据的简单记忆，而非检验真正的物理泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们绘制了钙钛矿数据库的机构来源图谱，并建立了一套严格的分组划分层级，逐步隔离重复的器件、出版物和机构。对十三个模型的基准测试在所有划分方式上建立了新的最先进性能，并揭示了一个关键的性能格局转变：树集成模型凭借对熟悉配方的识别在随机划分中占据主导，但在面对真正未见过的机构和未来新发现时排名大幅下滑，而成分感知的神经架构在这种情况下表现更为出色。此外，
tldr: 该论文指出钙钛矿光伏机器学习评估中随机数据划分会因海量重复数据导致信息泄漏，提出基于机构来源分组的严格评估协议，并揭示树集成模型仅擅长记忆熟悉配方、而成分感知神经架构在真正未知场景下泛化能力更强的规律。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes information leakage from random data splits in perovskite photovoltaics machine learning due to massive internal duplication, introduces a provenance-grouped evaluation protocol, and shows that tree ensembles dominate familiar recipes while composition-aware neural architectures generalize better to unseen institutions and future discoveries.
